Cost: 500eb (Expensive) for 1
Stack: 1

Thrown or launched. Scans a 10x10m/yds (5x5 square) area where it lands and sends the data to your Neuroport. Everyone there is marked for 9 seconds (3 Rounds): you see their outlines through cover, smoke, darkness, and other obscurement, and Smart or Improved Smart ammo gets +1 to hit them.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Ammunition).
